source_note: The 15 names originated in a founder inventory email. This registry treats that email as a hypothesis and uses repository paths, not the email, as implementation evidence.
boundaries: A present file is not proof of production readiness, customer adoption, external validation, or economic value.
A local test is evidence of bounded software behavior only.
Trading and sports lanes remain research and paper-only until prospective, after-cost evidence and applicable legal controls pass.
Hardware, XR, identity, energy, and smart-city claims remain conceptual or simulation-bound until independent domain validation exists.
Final government certifications, signatures, prices, uploads, and submissions remain human-controlled.

supplemental_discovery.scope_note: A targeted read-only scan covered project-like C-drive roots, non-sensitive iCloud folders, origin/main, and selected tested branches. Credentials, account data, personal identifiers, patent-sensitive contents, virtual environments, and bulk archives were excluded.
